generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential from 1, unique per table; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy from the FINAL retained parent key list (after primary-key dedup/filtering); nullable FKs get NULL share per null_targets; planted NULLs never overwritten; every non-NULL FK value must exist in the retained parent key set.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer in [min,max] from statistics; quantity > 0; song length (Milliseconds) in 50000..900000; Bytes NULL or in 1000000..50000000.
generic_sampling_rules.decimal_money: Two-decimal value in [0, 25.00]; boundary values at listed literals plus one step (0.01).
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_text: Random word/phrase within declared length; 5% near-variant (case flip, trailing space, doubled char).
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_enum: Pick from explicit enum pool; 5% case-variant of a pool value.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, plant NULL in the compact database's share of rows (from statistics), at least one per column, after all derived/FK rules; never overwrite a planted NULL; copied columns inherit parent NULL state exactly.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary: For columns with comparison_boundary targets, include literal, literal-1 step, literal+1 step.
generic_sampling_rules.like_near_variant: For LIKE targets, include literal, literal without trailing %, literal with extra char, case variant.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicates_for_distinct: For DISTINCT targets, ensure 20-50% duplicate share on that column.
generic_sampling_rules.ties_for_order_limit: For ORDER targets, plant at least two rows tied at the listed rank value.
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_join_rows: For join columns, deterministically reserve at least one parent row with no child and (if nullable) at least one child row with NULL FK, in addition to random FK sampling; all reserves drawn from the FINAL retained parent key list.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: For GROUP targets, deterministically produce groups of size 1, 2, and >=3 using only retained parent keys.

issues.requested_revision: In instance.py the FK columns are filled from the parent pool (fill_foreign_keys_consistently) before _reserve_unmatched/_enforce_group_sizes. _enforce_group_sizes overwrites Track.GenreId with rng.choice(keys) drawn from all GenreId values — including Genre rows whose IDs exist — but it uses pvals = inst[pt].get(pc) which is fine; however _reserve_unmatched re-points or leaves values, and _enforce_group_sizes uses parent keys shuffled from pvals but does not filter values already validated. More concretely, the parent pools include values that are later discarded by sample_fresh_primary_keys (which drops parent rows with duplicate PKs) — children still reference the dropped parent IDs. Fix by deriving FK values only from the final, retained parent key lists (after sample_fresh_primary_keys), and re-validate/inherit NULL propagation after all parent-key filtering. Also make Album.ArtistId and Track.GenreId derive from retained Artist/Genre key sets.

The current implementation does not enforce them, but the spec's group_sizes for self-referencing is trivially satisfied by PK uniqueness, so this is a spec ambiguity, not a blocker.
